# About the examples in voice/examples/

These passages are word-for-word excerpts from *The Architecture of Open Source Applications*, Volume 1
(https://aosabook.org), published under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 license
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). They are not covered by vela's MIT license. Each file's frontmatter names
its author, chapter, source link and license, and says it is unchanged; keep that attribution if you copy or share them.

They are public starting examples for the house voice. Once you add two of your own of a type with `/vela:voice-seed`,
that type's public examples step aside. Your own examples live in `voice/local/`, which git ignores.
